arena.note: owner choice 2026-10-19; MIT; bracket.py stdlib only, no network or subprocess at this commit
arena.author: Jake Schincariol
arena.when: a close or high-risk decision, or after two rejected answers
features: Runs many sub-agents on the same task (100 by default, 16 with --quick), each with a different strategy card
A single-elimination bracket: they attack each other's answers, defend and revise
A judge scores every match on a written rubric until one answer is left
Costly: many sub-agent calls, so master-brain only offers it and checks your usage first

unslop.when: a dashboard, landing page, app screen or any UI people will see, or a screen that looks AI-made
unslop.credit: unslop by Damir Sokolovsky (@heydamir), CC BY 4.0
unslop.note: scanned 2026-11-27: 0 high; network only inside snapshot.mjs for the page the user names; story.mjs serves files on 127.0.0.1 with a path guard and runs ffmpeg
unslop.author: Damir Sokolovsky (@heydamir)
features: Audits a screen for the usual signs of AI-made UI: purple gradients, glows, emoji icons, uppercase labels, uneven spacing, hype copy
Writes a five-line design direction from the product itself and asks you before changing anything
Fixes the screen in nine passes: spacing, color, icons, copy, type, layout, details, visuals, motion
Exact values: a 4 px spacing scale, neutral color ramps, a type scale, corner radii and motion timings
Right-to-left rules for Arabic, Persian, Urdu and Hebrew
Optional: saves a live page to work on (needs Playwright) and makes a 10-second before/after video (Playwright and ffmpeg)
Optional: writes hero image prompts, or generates the image if you have an image tool (asks before spending)

security-audit.author: Cloudflare
security-audit.when: a security review, audit or pen test, or a release that touches auth, payments or user data
features: Source-first security review of codebases, APIs, services, CLI tools, libraries and daemons
Quick, standard and deep modes; only vulnerabilities that cross a real trust boundary count
Guides for web auth and protocols, client side, cloud and deploy, AI and LLM, supply chain, memory safety, data isolation, denial of service and local IPC
Each finding comes with source evidence, a safe reproduction, a priority and the smallest fix
Node validators for the findings report and the coverage ledger
security-audit.note: scanned 2026-11-27: 0 high; the only subprocess and delete calls are in its own tests (temp folders)
